failed_step.name: vanilla_clean
failed_step.exception: RuntimeError: vanilla embeddings are not L2 normalized

evidence: The public OmniEmbedAdapter calls torch.nn.functional.normalize before returning embeddings.
The locked model runs in BF16, and the adapter normalizes before converting its output to float32.
The failed consumer converted the adapter output to float32 and then required all row norms to be within atol=1e-3 without applying the protocol-required cache-boundary normalization.
root_cause_assessment.most_likely_cause: BF16 normalization quantization exposed by a stricter float32 norm assertion at the cache boundary

repair_policy.action: Apply deterministic float32 row-wise L2 normalization at the vanilla cache boundary and record pre/post norm statistics.
repair_policy.impact_assessment: Scalar row normalization preserves embedding direction and enforces the declared cosine-space protocol; the rerun audit will quantify the pre-normalization deviations.
